This took me forever to get right for /v/pcmasterrace, so I decided to show what I accomplished here in case someone liked it. /v/pcmasterracetest show what this looks like in practice. It essentially rips .side .spacer.spacersection from .side and makes it sit on the left of #container. It only does it at or above a width of 1700px. 

@media (min-width: 1700px) {
 .side .spacer.spacersection {
 position: fixed;
 top: 89px; /* Assuming no banner. */
 left: 10px;
 width: calc(((100% - 1200px) / 2) - 20px);
 padding: 4px;
 border-radius: 3px; /* Just makes the border round like #container. */
 }
}
@media (min-width: 1969px) {
 .side .spacer.spacersection {
 width: 361px;
 left: calc(((100% - 1200px) / 2) - 371px);
 }
}

Edit: You should also put something like this in it because the top of the chatbox is cut off. Put it under @media (min-width: 1700px).

.subverseChatRoomContent {
 margin-top: 45px;
}
